cards.title: git clone
cards.body: `git clone <url>` downloads a whole repository from GitHub into a new folder named after it, with `origin` already set up.

cards.title: Then go inside
cards.body: The clone is a folder like any other: `cd` into it to start working.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: `cd` fails right after the clone. Which line is wrong?
cards.code:
git clone https://github.com/loophole/recipes.git
cd recipes.git
git log --oneline

bug.fix: The new folder is named after the repository, without `.git`: `cd recipes`.

check.question: You run `git clone https://github.com/ada/notes.git`. Which folder appears?
check.explanation: The folder takes the repository's name, without `.git`.

exercise.prompt: Clone `https://github.com/loophole/demo.git`, then go into its folder.
